state.user_question: Can I export my data to CSV?

matched_faq.question: How do I export my data?
matched_faq.canonical_answer: You can export your data to CSV or JSON from Settings > Data > Export. XML export was discontinued in v4.0 (June 2025).

passages.text: To export your data, go to Settings > Data > Export and choose CSV, JSON, or XML.
CSV export is available under Settings > Data > Export.
